title: Eurycoma longifolia essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Eurycoma longifolia essential oil is a potent aromatic extract derived from the roots of the Eurycoma longifolia plant, commonly known as Tongkat Ali. It is widely used in traditional herbal medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its purported adaptogenic and aphrodisiac properties. The oil is often employed to enhance vitality, reduce stress, and support sexual health due to its active compounds like quassinoids. In herbalism, it is typically diluted with a carrier oil and applied topically or used in aromatherapy to promote energy and well-being. Its use extends to supporting immune function and improving physical performance in various traditional practices.
